### Added

- *(muster,ui-react)* Add a page per MCP server and per tool in [#2675](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2675) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster)* List MCP servers in one flat table with a server and tool search in [#2676](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2676) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster,agent-platform)* MCP Servers and Workflows as Agent Platform tabs in [#2682](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2682) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)

### Changed

- *(deps)* Update ai-sdk packages in [#2678](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2678) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(deps)* Update dependency prettier to v3.9.7 in [#2681](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2681) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])

### Fixed

- *(gs,kubernetes-react)* Skip the KubeadmControlPlane fetch for managed control planes in [#2652](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2652) by [@luca-rui](https://github.com/luca-rui)
- *(kubernetes-react,gs,agent-platform)* One error helper for every Kubernetes proxy request in [#2671](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2671) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(gs,kubernetes-react)* Render the cluster About card without a control plane reference in [#2673](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2673) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)
- *(muster,agent-platform,gs)* Hide single-option installation pickers, drop ad-hoc server add in [#2638](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2638) by [@Rotfuks](https://github.com/Rotfuks)
